name: Sovereign Deep Research Studio (5-Phase Monograph)
description: 5-phase autonomous investigation loop: Deep ReAct primary ingest (200 turns), evidence audit, long-form monograph synthesis with verification/quarantine gating, editorial soul.md critique, and Three Degrees PGP packaging.

inputs.name: topic
inputs.label: Research Inquiry Topic
inputs.placeholder: e.g. [empirical] EUTxO Concurrency Models and Minswap Batcher Queue Determinism

phases.name: Phase 1: Deep ReAct Investigation & Primary Ingest
phases.description: Multi-turn ReAct exploration that downloads primary papers, runs empirical searches, analyzes diagrams, and accumulates verified citations into scratchpad.md.
phases.prompt_template: Phase 1 is driven by research_graph.sh domain instructions (academic, engineering, finance, gaming, sports/auto) with full scratchpad.md citation accumulation.

phases.name: Phase 2: Evidence Audit & Gap Analysis
phases.description: Audits scratchpad.md for source diversity, quantitative grounding, and missing counter-evidence before monograph drafting.

phases.name: Phase 3: Long-Form Technical Monograph Synthesis
phases.description: Synthesizes the authoritative long-form technical monograph (dossier.md) and runs verification gating (quarantines if citations or primitive audits fail).

phases.name: Phase 4: Editorial Critique & soul.md Refinement
phases.description: Performs a rigorous editorial polish pass to eliminate filler, tighten technical claims, and align voice with soul.md.

phases.name: Phase 5: Three Degrees Audit & Publication Packaging
phases.description: Runs final Three Degrees verification, renders summary plate PNG, PGP Ed25519 signs deliverables, archives in Sovereign Library, and stages social threads.
